note: Covers unchanged from the prior claim (EXCLUSIONS, BuiltLandmarks/justiceHouse place() calls, the 10 hero-statue place() calls + tint convention, the complete street-statue/bust instancing system, and the 10 no-OBJ procedural landmarks' real merged massing). THIS PASS ADDS real per-vertex UV coordinates to the box()/cyl()/hemisphere primitive pipeline (Buf.UV; AddBox = per-face 0..1 quad UVs; AddCyl = side wraps the full 0..1 circumference + radial-fan caps; AddHemisphere = equirectangular) and uploads them in MakeMesh (mesh.SetUVs(0, ...)). Not counted as NEW js-line coverage (three.js's own BoxGeometry/CylinderGeometry UV generation is an internal library default, not an explicit landmarks.js line to cite — same posture AirportBuilder.cs already took for its dot-matrix-geometry-instead-of-canvas-texture substitution), but it is the real, necessary precondition for LandmarkFacades.cs's new mapping table to mean anything: before this change every one of these 10 landmarks' meshes had ZERO texture coordinates, so even a correctly assigned photo material would have sampled a single texel across the whole surface.
verified: Not run (cannot launch the Unity editor). Hand-verified: AddBox's 4 UV corners (0,0)/(1,0)/(1,1)/(0,1) match its own existing p0..p3 vertex order (p0=-right-up, p1=+right-up, p2=+right+up, p3=-right+up) exactly, a standard CCW quad parameterisation; AddCyl's side u0=i/seg,u1=(i+1)/seg reproduces three.js CylinderGeometry's own circumference wrap; mesh.SetUVs is gated on `b.UV.Count == n` (n = vertex count) so a mismatched call fails silent-but-harmless (no UVs applied) rather than throwing. LandmarkFacadesProbe.cs's own uvOk=true/false per landmark (see that entry) is the intended follow-up check, not run here for the same editor-access reason.
